content.value: Strings are immutable. Build a result in a separate String, or reassign the reference after concatenation. Traverse with indices from zero through length() - 1. substring(i, i + 1) extracts one character; equals compares its content. Common algorithms count matches, reverse text, and find substrings.

The indices are 4, 3, 2, 1, 0. The result is level, so palindrome is true. An empty string runs the loop zero times. Using i <= word.length() in a forward character loop would eventually request an invalid substring.
